model_annotation: Figure 3 shows the results of a survey on the role of design in the organization. The survey was conducted among 110 respondents. The majority of respondents (52) believe that design is a process, not a product. 41 respondents believe that design is a way to produce data. 14 respondents believe that design is standardized, and 16 respondents believe that design is experimental. 13 respondents believe that design is a tool, and 10 respondents believe that design is not clear or is not important.
